text:
jordana: quick flag from docs review - the private deployment audit-log section says "logs are removed after TTL" which reads like a hard delete and doesn't mention legal hold or investigations. link: https://redwood.example/docs/private/audit-ops#retention

kevin: good catch. SOC2 reviewers will want explicit exceptions. can you paste the sentence?

jordana: current text: "Audit logs are retained for the configured TTL and are deleted thereafter."

maggie: that's terse. recommend: add an explicit clause about legal holds, investigations, and regulatory holds; and point to internal Legal Hold Playbook.

samira: Legal: confirm we must preserve logs under hold even if TTL expires. yes, note that holds require manual release or court order. also mention exported archives must remain accessible/undeleted while under hold.

kevin: agreed. let's add a tiny example showing how to mark an export as under legal hold via SDK + curl, so ops/devs see the API surface. keep it minimal.

maggie: drafted a compact Node snippet and a curl example for the PR. also normalized the field name to camelCase to match SDK conventions.

jordana: PR opened: #4142. Summary: replace one line with two lines clarifying exceptions; add Node SDK snippet and curl example; add internal link to legal playbook. pinging for review.

kevin: reviewing now, minor nit: make the SDK snippet show success response shape with 1-line comment. helps QA.

maggie: updated snippet accordingly. Node example: ```js
// mark export as under legal hold
await redwood.auditExports.update(exportId, { legalHold: true }); // { id: exportId, legalHold: true }
// to release: { legalHold: false }
```

samira: also add a short note about encryption: if export is encrypted via customer-managed keys, we must preserve key access while on hold. otherwise data could be inaccessible. add link to KMS docs.

jordana: added the encryption note and KMS link. PR now contains the wording tweak, Node snippet, curl example, and KMS link.

docs-bot: docs build started. running link checks and lint.

docs-bot: docs/check-links finished: 1 external link warning (ok), internal links clean.

kevin: LGTM besides a tiny voice tweak. approving and will merge after the docs CI finishes. I'll also add a line in the SOC2 reviewer checklist so this isn't overlooked in future audits.

jordana: thanks! will follow up to replicate the wording on the retention FAQ and the private-deployments summary page.

maggie: great. closing thread once merged. :white_check_mark: :rocket:
